latest.title: Hot nights linked to more OHCA
latest.finding: Nighttime heat exposure increased OHCA hospitalisation (RR 1.090, 95% CI 1.047–1.135); RR rose to 1.295 in people ≥75 and 1.352 in women in northern regions, and risk was higher where air-conditioning penetration was low

latest.title: ECPR for OHCA: pump the brakes
latest.finding: Only ARREST (30 patients) strongly favoured ECPR; INCEPTION and Prague OHCA were not statistically significant, and the authors argue intra-arrest transport effects cannot be excluded as a driver of reported benefit

latest.title: How ambulance models shape end-of-life care
latest.finding: Learning on the job and limited access to records, anticipatory medicines and palliative advice dominated practice across all three models; paramedic workload was driven partly by primary and community service shortages

latest.title: Scene-to-door time and stroke thrombectomy
latest.finding: In patients with pre-stroke disability (mRS ≥1), longer scene-to-door time independently reduced favourable 90-day outcome (adjusted OR 0.91, 95% CI 0.81–0.98; optimal cutoff 14 min); no significant association in the overall cohort (AUC 0.57)
